near_domain: different prompt and median P16 MV norm within 1 pixel of any support video
prior: Laplace-smoothed per-frame raster coefficient frequency, conditional on training legal masks
replay_gate: For the same arm in both folds and both training seeds, paired video bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 for held-out AP and written top-4 recall versus both raster prior and random opportunity, on B and D. Diagnostic readers have no student export.
readout: GZ1 matched PCA32 from support only, L2 cosine top-1/5 and balanced ridge linear probe; F1 advantage requires positive-class AP and recall improvement in both folds
